FTK2.Armory — overnight content drop

116 items (109 with remixed icons) across 5 packs — 9 hand-crafted sets + 13 standalone artifacts + 60 curated forge rolls. All packs: 0 validator errors. Tooling: vocab extractor, iconforge, itemforge (3 profiles, seeded), validator, compiler — 40 tests green. Read with: CATALOG.md (set design), SPEC.md, INSTALL.md (manual install — nothing touched your game directory), docs/research/game-mechanics.md (claim ground truth), docs/research/forge-tuning-notes.md (randomness knobs).
Needs in-game verification (nothing below could be tested without launching the game):
  1. Install per INSTALL.md (EOR path), check BepInEx log for Custom item framework ready. ThingsAdded=116 and zero Custom item skipped ARM_ warnings.
  2. Give-item ARM_BRAMBLE_AEGIS — tooltip, stats, donor shield model render.
  3. Give-item ARM_REDSEASON_CULLERS_BOW — confirm it attacks and the bleed ability appears.
  4. Give-item ARM_HOLLOW_COURTIER (combat consumable) — confirm the summon fires.
  5. Trinket icon check: ARM_UNIQ_KINGSBANE should show its remixed PNG under EOR.
  6. Market/loot appearance: tier 0-1 town market for a COMMON piece (e.g. ARM_BRAMBLE_MACE); a few combat drops.
  7. Cursed drawback renders: ARM_ASHEN_PENITENT_PLATE negative stats visible.
  8. MP hash handshake still passes with packs installed on both peers (SPEC §9 / OQ1).
Open questions / flags for review:
  • Rarity mix is top-heavy (RARE 52 / ARTIFACT 43 of 116) — fine vs the 5% ARTIFACT loot bucket, but tell me if you want a commons-heavy second batch.
  • Icon display for non-trinket classes needs the M3 micro-plugin (eor-loader-notes §2); icons are already rendered and shipped for it.
  • chaotic_epics profile runs AWR/THRN/DAM_* hot vs live norms by design — first balance-pass targets.
  • Set-bonus engine (M2) would make the 9 sets mechanically cohesive; id prefixes are ready.
